name: Swept Volumes via Spacetime Numerical Continuation
definition: A method to compute the swept volume of a moving shape (brush) by solving for the minimum signed distance function (SDF) over time using numerical continuation, outputting sparse cells (CS, CV, CI) representing the spacetime trajectory.
summary: Swept Volumes via Spacetime Numerical Continuation computes exact swept volumes by solving for the minimum signed distance function over time, outputting sparse trajectory-based cells that enable sharp feature reconstruction via dual contouring.
